item.title: Hopes and Dreams
item.description:
Hey keerthana,

I love you.

I want to keep falling in love while you talk about stuff. I’d love to let you rest your tired head on my shoulders after a long day.

I want to show you my love so much. I just pray to god that you feel the same way for me.

I want to do everything I can to make you happy. I want to help you reach your hopes and dreams. I wish I’m everything you’ve dreamt of and more.

item.title: Princess KT
item.description:
I deleted all of kt’s chat like the impulsive asshole I am.

I made so many mistakes - time to analyse them then.

Date: 12-08-2026

Kt is the sweetest and nicest girl I’ve ever met. I fell for her immediately, which I suspect is for her passion (and slight crazy nature).

But as always, I can’t be trusted with good things. I messed up, I was careless and never checked up on her. Ever since deciding to give “this” a shot, I’ve been slacking.
